transcript.text: Alright, I have an unused parking space in my narrow driveway available for the summer, running June 1 through July 31. Before I decide who gets it, I'm going to do my usual round-robin check. I'll call Jonah first, then Rina, then Cal, and I'll write down each person's complete offer or any measured driveway concern before I make my decision. Just so everyone knows upfront: whoever I accept must cover the full June 1–July 31 period, repaint the faded curb numbers, and sweep the driveway once a week. If a proposal is missing either of those requirements, it won't be acceptable. Let me get started on the calls.
